sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Salaries of certain public officers to be charged on the Consolidated Fund
maudhui: (1) There shall be paid to the public officers to whom this Article applies such salaries and allowances as may be prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament. (2) The salaries and allowances payable to the public officers to whom this Article applies, together with pensions and gratuities payable to those entitled to them, shall be a charge upon the Consolidated Fund. (3) The salary payable to a public officer to whom this Article applies together with his terms of service shall not be altered to his disadvantage after his appointment to that office, but the provisions of this subarticle shall not apply to allowances payable to such public officer. (4) Where a public officer to whom this Article applies has an option as to the rate of salary or the terms of service, the rate of salary and the terms of service which he opts for shall, for the purposes of subarticle (3) of this Article, be deemed to be more advantageous to him than any other rate of salary or terms of service which he could have opted for. (5) This Article shall apply to a Justice of Appeal, a Judge of the High Court of the United Republic, the Chairman and every member of the Commission for Human Rights and Good Governance and the Controller and Auditor-General of the United Republic.
vifungu: (1) There shall be paid to the public officers to whom this Article applies such salaries and allowances as may be prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament.

(2) The salaries and allowances payable to the public officers to whom this Article applies, together with pensions and gratuities payable to those entitled to them, shall be a charge upon the Consolidated Fund.

(3) The salary payable to a public officer to whom this Article applies together with his terms of service shall not be altered to his disadvantage after his appointment to that office, but the provisions of this subarticle shall not apply to allowances payable to such public officer.

(4) Where a public officer to whom this Article applies has an option as to the rate of salary or the terms of service, the rate of salary and the terms of service which he opts for shall, for the purposes of subarticle (3) of this Article, be deemed to be more advantageous to him than any other rate of salary or terms of service which he could have opted for.

(5) This Article shall apply to a Justice of Appeal, a Judge of the High Court of the United Republic, the Chairman and every member of the Commission for Human Rights and Good Governance and the Controller and Auditor-General of the United Republic.
